desc:
🛴 Kukirin Empire! 🚔💨

🔥 Hop on your E-scooter, hit the streets, and show off your best wheelies! Can you outrun the cops and become the best rider in the city? 👀

🛴 Ride different E-scooters and wheelie them!
🔥 Do Crazy wheelies and stunts around the map!
🚔 Escape the cops and avoid getting caught!
💰 Earn money by Wheeling and Running from police!
🏁 Unlock and buy better, faster E-scooters!
🌆 Explore the city, and highways!

⚠️ BETA RELEASE NOTICE
This game is currently in BETA! 🛠️ Expect bugs, new features, balancing changes, and improvements. Everything is subject to change as development continues. Your feedback helps make the game better! ❤️

💙 LIKE 👍 AND FAVORITE ⭐ THE GAME TO SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT!

🛴💨 Ride fast. Wheelie hard. Don't get caught. 🚔
